targets.title: First complete care cycle
acceptance: Keep the same synthetic household and garment across the entire care cycle.
Record confirmed actions and inputs; a failed operation must not advance the journey.

targets.title: Multicolor pack with shared care
acceptance: Record both ownership branches, color quantities and shared-care confirmation in one continuous run.

targets.title: Change garment wash and dry preferences
acceptance: Retain the selected garment and quantity through save, cancel and retry.
Preferences must never override care-label limits.

targets.title: Delete account confirmation
acceptance: Use a synthetic account and explicit confirmation; do not send a real deletion request.

targets.title: Active-use wash cadence and reminders
acceptance: Use explicitly reported use; clean stored inventory does not accumulate assumed wear.
Provide pause, snooze and recipient-aware reminders.

targets.title: Condition checks and replacement tracking
acceptance: Record reported condition and quantity; do not infer failure or remaining life from age.

targets.title: Additional item-specific care warnings
acceptance: Use confirmed item restrictions; do not invent chemical permissions or safe treatments.

targets.title: Storage, folding and put-away guidance
acceptance: Distinguish an actual recorded placement from a suggested storage method.

targets.title: Delegated care with helper permissions
acceptance: Explicitly scope access and assigned work; membership alone does not authorize a helper.

targets.title: Native platform journey variants
acceptance: Retain shared intent while recording approved platform adaptations separately from unreviewed drift.

targets.title: Recover from a washer problem
acceptance: Show door and dispenser problems, retained preparation and failed recalculation.
A failed retry retains the washer selection and preparation state.
